title.zh: 安妮公主 — 黑胡桃拼花

short_description.en: Special-shaped parquet series. Black walnut with Italian coating on Russian birch base. 785×785mm. ENF certified.
short_description.ru: Паркет специальной формы. Черный орех, 785×785мм, итальянское покрытие на российской березе. ENF.
short_description.zh: 异性拼花系列。黑胡桃材质，785×785mm，意式涂装，俄罗斯进口全桦基材。ENF认证。

body.en:
## Anne Princess Walnut Parquet

The Anne Princess design in rich black walnut. Large 785×785mm format with Italian coating. A bold statement for grand interiors.

### Specifications
- **Wood Species**: Black Walnut
- **Model**: Anne Princess
- **Size**: 785×785mm
- **Finish**: Italian Coating
- **Base**: Russian Imported Birch
- **Lock**: Flat Lock
- **Certification**: ENF
